mapper.sql: WITH scm02 AS ( SELECT scm02_sr_appr_step.* , emp01_person.* , f_get_empTrans(emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS emp00_title_nm , emp01_company_id AS emp00_company_id , org02_kor_nm AS org00_kor_nm FROM scm02_sr_appr_step INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = scm02_step_emp_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans t2 ON ( emp03_person_id = scm02_step_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date = ( SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = scm02_step_emp_id AND emp03_trans_date <= COALESCE(scm02_appr_date, f_today()) )) INNER JOIN org01_code ON org01_code_id = emp03_org_code_id INNER JOIN org02_info ON ( org02_code_id = org01_code_id AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info WHERE org02_code_id = emp03_org_code_id AND org02_mod_date <= emp03_trans_date )) WHERE 1=1 AND ${cond} ) SELECT scm02_sr_appr_step_id AS sr_appr_step_id , scm02_sr_id AS sr_id , scm02_step_type_cd AS step_type_cd , scm02_seq AS seq , scm02_step_status_cd AS step_status_cd , scm02_appr_date AS appr_date , scm02_note AS note , scm02_reject_reason AS reject_reason , scm02_step_emp_id AS step_emp_id , scm02_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , f_cdnm('AprStepTypeCode', scm02_step_type_cd, emp00_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS step_type_nm , f_cdnm('AprStepStatusCode', scm02_step_status_cd, emp00_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS step_status_nm , emp00_title_nm || ' ' || emp01_kor_nm AS step_appr_name , org00_kor_nm AS org_kor_nm , emp00_title_nm AS title_nm , emp01_kor_nm AS emp_kor_nm FROM scm02 ORDER BY f_to_number(scm02_seq), scm02_step_type_cd, scm02_sr_appr_step_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm02_sr_appr_step (scm02_sr_appr_step_id, scm02_sr_id, scm02_step_type_cd, scm02_seq, scm02_step_status_cd, scm02_appr_date, scm02_note, scm02_reject_reason, scm02_step_emp_id, scm02_appr_emp_id) VALUES (#{srApprStepId}, #{srId}, #{req.stepTypeCd}, #{req.seq}, #{req.stepStatusCd}, #{req.apprDate}, #{req.note}, #{req.rejectReason}, #{req.stepEmpId}, #{req.apprEmpId})
